evidence.claim: Real-time legacy risk score flagged transaction 3506725 with an elevated score of 0.90.
The bank's second-generation calibrated fraud model scored transaction 3506725 at 0.019, with an expected historical fraud rate of only 0.006 (0.6%).

The flagged transaction occurred in region 469, which is the cardholder's primary billing region accounting for 24 of 33 prior transactions, and shows zero fraud lift (lift 0.0) across 206 transactions in the 7-day window.
Device D000126 is marked as New for this account, though it represents a generic browser configuration.
Device D000126 is a generic desktop browser profile (Windows 10, Edge 16.0) used by 208 cards all time, operated without a proxy, and carries no ring association (ring_id -1).
Louvain community detection places card C10434-K1 in an isolated single-card community (community 146800700) with 0 confirmed fraud cases and a lift vs base rate of 0.0.
Card C10434-K1 has regular established activity in online channels (16 prior transactions) and product category R (9 prior transactions), with no card testing sequences.
While the $1,000.03 charge is higher than recent online transactions, card C10434-K1 has prior substantial purchases reaching $670.04 (tx 3306585) and $670.00 (tx 3217858) without anomalies.
Prior closed alert CC-0873 on card C10434-K1 was triggered by an elevated model score of 0.93 and was cleared as legitimate activity.

case.summary: Transaction 3506725 ($1,000.03, online) on card C10434-K1 was flagged due to an elevated legacy real-time risk score of 0.90. In contrast, the bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model evaluated the transaction at 0.019, reflecting a historical fraud rate of only 0.6%. The purchase occurred in region 469, which represents the cardholder's primary billing region, using a generic desktop browser profile with no proxy use or fraud ring connections. In addition, the cardholder possesses an established history of online transactions, sits in an isolated community with zero fraud lift, and had a prior alert (CC-0873) cleared as legitimate. The alert is determined to be a false alarm, and the case is closed with no fraud.
